description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Only 880 yards to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Great Outdoor Areas for Dining + Relaxing* 4 Bikes Included * Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park * Tennis Courts, Nature Trails and Fitness Center * Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!*Please note, this home has a maximum occupancy of 8 guests. 8 wristbands will be left inside the home at check-in. Each guest much wear a wristband at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse. Guests will be charged $100 for each lost wristband.*Welcome to "This is Living"!Situated in the beautiful Cypress Dunes community, just off the scenic Hwy 30A, This is Living is a stunning 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home designed for those seeking the ultimate beach getaway. With its cozy atmosphere and ideal location, this vacation rental offers everything you need for a memorable escape to the Emerald Coast. Step inside to find a bright and spacious open-concept living area, complete with beautiful wood flooring that enhances the home’s warm and inviting ambiance. The layout is perfect for family gatherings, where everyone can come together to relax or entertain. The professional-grade kitchen features sleek quartz countertops and is fully equipped to prepare delicious home-cooked meals for your loved ones. Designed to accommodate up to 8 guests, this home offers a variety of comfortable sleeping arrangements for every member of the family. The first-floor Master Suite features a luxurious King-sized bed, while a second King Master Suite on the second floor offers extra privacy and comfort. The home also includes a Queen bed in the first guest bedroom, a Full bed in the second guest bedroom, and 2 Full-over-Full bunk beds in the third guest bedroom, providing plenty of space and flexibility for larger groups or families. Whether you’re lounging in the cozy living room, cooking in the well-appointed kitchen, or relaxing in one of the tranquil bedrooms, This is Living is the perfect place to unwind and enjoy all the best that beach living has to offer. Come experience why This is Living will quickly become one of your favorite vacation destinations.Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches all the way to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Master Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd Floor Master Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Full BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 Full over Full Bunk BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
